# Repository-wide coding assistant instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and any affected subproject instructions. For optional changes, apply [docs/VALUES_PRETASK_GATE.md](../docs/VALUES_PRETASK_GATE.md) before recommending or editing: protect stated family, faith, sleep, wellbeing and community commitments; check reuse/consolidation/defer/no-build alternatives; identify the intended human benefit, verification evidence and stopping condition. The user's agency, privacy and documented safety/security/data-loss exceptions are preserved. Do not invent personal facts or claim that commits, tests, or the presence of this policy prove real-life benefit. The monthly [values and outcomes review](../docs/MONTHLY_VALUES_OUTCOMES_REVIEW.md) is private-first and read-only by default.
